title: Build deterministic rules-pack ingestion pipeline
description:
Create the infrastructure and work plan needed to replace minimal placeholder D&D SRD and Pathfinder rules fixtures with complete, licensed, deterministic rules-pack data.

The core policy is: licensed source -> deterministic extraction -> schema validation -> coverage tests -> audit. Do not use an LLM as the source of truth for rules data. Models may assist parser development and audits, but generated pack contents must be reproducible from approved source material.
design: This epic is about deterministic rules-pack population, not rules-engine automation completeness. Full reference coverage comes first. Mechanical automation can remain partial and layered on afterward.
acceptance_criteria:
- Rules-pack ingestion approach is documented.
- Source/license/provenance metadata exists.
- Kind-specific rules record schemas are defined.
- Generated-data layout and pack loader are established.
- D&D SRD importer work is tracked.
- Pathfinder source-policy and importer work is tracked.
- Coverage/audit tooling work is tracked.
- The plan explicitly forbids model-generated authoritative rules content.
notes: Deferred 2026-06-16. Epic blocked on Pathfinder children (0m9.8, 0m9.9) which are deferred pending campaign validation. D&D SRD work (all other children) is complete.
